# largest comp ball, fit circle to boundary via outer extents all rows
num,lab,stats,cents=cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(mask.astype('uint8'),8)
ids=np.argsort(stats[1:,cv2.CC_STAT_AREA])[::-1]+1
print('top comps',[(int(i),stats[i].tolist()) for i in ids[:8]])

for i in ids[:10]:

# infer circle from observed full extents ignoring holes/black grooves: get edge cols for each row where mask exists within ball comp
ballid=None

m=lab==ballid

 xs=np.where(m[y])[0]
 if len(xs)>2:rows.append((y,int(xs.min()),int(xs.max()),len(xs)))

  # only top/bottom? ends boundary
  pts.append((xs.min(),y));pts.append((xs.max(),y))

# choose extent-based optimum: center from horizontal extents at several rows
for y in [0,20,40,60,80,100,120,140,160,180,200,220,240]:
